workingPrinciple: The system operates on an embedded real-time feedback loop managed by a central microcontroller. Ultrasonic sensors continuously emit high-frequency acoustic pulses and measure the time-of-flight of the reflected echo to determine the distance of forward obstacles. If a barrier is detected within a predefined threshold (e.g., 20 cm), the microcontroller sends PWM signals to an H-bridge motor driver, halting the DC gear motors and executing a timed directional turn to chart a clear path. Simultaneously, auxiliary analog and digital sensors (such as DHT11 for temperature/humidity) sample environmental parameters at periodic intervals. These readings are parsed and instantly updated on a local I2C display interface to provide real-time telemetry.
majorHardwareComponents:
Microcontroller: Arduino Uno (ATmega328P) / ESP32 development board
Sensing Units: HC-SR04 Ultrasonic Sensor

DHT11 Temperature & Humidity Sensor
Actuation & Drive: L298N Dual H-Bridge Motor Driver Module

1x Micro Servo Motor (SG90)
Power Management: 2x 18650 Li-ion batteries (7.4V nominal) with LM2596 step-down buck converter (regulated 5V logic rail)
Display & Chassis: 16x2 I2C LCD screen
potentialImpact:
Hazardous Environment Inspection: Replaces human personnel in tight, toxic, or unstable structures—such as collapsed buildings, chemical storage rooms, or underground pipelines—to assess physical integrity and ambient safety without risking human life.
Cost-Effective Industrial Automation: Serves as a modular, low-cost baseline for automated internal logistics, periodic warehouse monitoring, and routine floor inspections in small-to-medium enterprises (SMEs) that cannot afford complex enterprise robotic fleets.
Precision Agriculture & Greenhouses: Automates localized microclimate surveying in indoor farming facilities, detecting hot spots or humidity pockets directly at canopy level for targeted climate control.
Disaster Response & First-Line Reconnaissance: Provides first responders with rapid ground-truth environmental data (air temperature, path accessibility, structural clearances) before rescue crews enter compromised disaster sites.
auraDemoHighlight:
Tangible Autonomous Decision-Making: Unlike standard remote-controlled rovers, it demonstrates full edge-level autonomy—processing ultrasonic spatial data in real time to calculate clearances and execute collision-avoidance maneuvers without external human intervention.
Low-Cost Engineering Feasibility: Proves that an industrial-grade inspection and monitoring concept can be functional, reliable, and deployable under ₹2,000 using standard embedded hardware.
Compact Multi-Disciplinary Integration: Combines mechanical chassis dynamics, precise H-bridge motor driver PWM control, low-voltage power regulation, and live sensor telemetry into a single unified mobile unit.
Modular, Scalable Architecture: Serves as a versatile physical testbed that can be quickly upgraded with additional payload modules—such as gas detectors, thermal probes, or wireless communication—with zero foundational redesign.
safetyPrecautions:
Battery Protection: Integrated BMS prevents overcharge, deep discharge, and short circuits in the 18650 Li-ion cells to eliminate fire risk.
Electrical Isolation: Independent voltage regulation via an LM2596 buck converter shields sensitive microcontroller logic from inductive back-EMF voltage spikes.
Inductive Clamp Diodes: Built-in flyback diodes on the motor driver suppress transient surges from DC gear motors.
Firmware Fail-Safes: Hard-coded emergency stall logic instantly cuts motor power if forward distance drops below a critical threshold (under 5 cm).
